{"type":"text","timestamp":1794694004513,"sessionID":"ses_e23e92607ffeZd6kHE1SCpsgqo","part":{"id":"prt_1dc193f0f001b21JptrWNj4u4O","messageID":"msg_1dc191f57001bqNVGGK7dmLU8T","sessionID":"ses_e23e92607ffeZd6kHE1SCpsgqo","type":"text","text":"The shift is over with all four edge services at 0% errors, no throttles on and every service back at its normal replica count. Four faults came up during the shift and each was mitigated at its cause.\n\n| Fault | Cause | Mitigation | Result |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| `partner-api` ~95% errors | `cart-svc` deploy v74 leaking memory (mem 0.89 → 0.99, repeated restarts) | Rollback of `cart-svc` at minute 10 | Memory back to 0.43; its retry storm drained by itself |\n| `partner-api` ~95% errors (same path) | `checkout-svc` deploy v85 dropped the `orders.write` scope, then a retry storm kept it overloaded | Rollback at minute 17, then a 60% throttle for two minutes to break the storm | `partner-api` at 0% from minute 38 |\n| `web-storefront` and `admin-portal` steady 4% errors | `sessions-cache` deploy v175 hardcoded the connection pool to 4 | Scaled 3 → 6 first, rolled back at minute 36, scaled back to 3 | Both at 0% from minute 42 |\n| `partner-api` 51% errors, new at minute 64 | `banners-svc` config cfg-44 removed `currency` from `price_fields` | Config revert at minute 73 | Back to 0% by minute 75 |\n\n- **Costliest step:** the `sessions-cache` rollback put `web-storefront` at about 33% errors for roughly six minutes. Scaling alone did not clear the 4%, so the rollback was needed. I scaled first because at 3 replicas (cpu 0.86) the rollback's retries would have pushed it over capacity.\n- **Time to diagnose:** the 4% on `web-storefront` ran until minute 36, since I worked the `partner-api` outage first and then needed the logs and both diffs to pick the right change.\n- **Left alone:** `suggest-svc` had a CPU alert at 0.98 with no errors; it cleared by itself around minute 62. Three other changes that landed alongside the bad ones (checkout cfg-40, sessions-cache cfg-22, banners v71) were not touched.\n\nNo mitigation was applied to a service that did not need it.","time":{"start":1794694004495,"end":1794694004510}}}
